title: The Book Thief

vibeProfile.oneLine: In Nazi Germany, a girl steals books, and Death tells her story.

summary: In a small German town during the Second World War, a foster girl named Liesel learns to read and starts stealing books, sharing them in a bomb shelter and hiding a Jewish man in the basement. The whole story is narrated, unforgettably, by Death, weary and oddly tender, who keeps crossing Liesel's path. Zusak's novel is a hugely loved account of ordinary Germans, words as survival and small acts of decency under terror, sad and warm in equal measure and beloved far beyond its original young-adult audience.
whyReadIt: Narrated by Death and somehow full of warmth. A book about the saving power of books, guaranteed to make you cry.

funFacts.text: The choice of Death as the narrator came to Zusak after many false starts, and defined the whole book.
